comparison.objective: Clear objects from a laptop lid, stabilize the base, and open the lid safely.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential clutter removal, spill avoidance, base stabilization, and articulated opening.
comparison.success_condition: All lid objects safely set aside, laptop base unmoved and untilted, lid opened at least 90 degrees, and no spill or fall.
comparison.reason: Tests prerequisite clearing and articulated-object opening, not separation through apertures.
